items.name: Alex Chen
items.content: YouFen really solved our community's pain points! Members' contributions can finally be quantified, and everyone's participation has noticeably increased 🎉

items.name: Sarah Lee
items.content: No-code community governance is perfect for non-technical organizers like us! The AI rule generation feature is incredibly useful 👍

items.name: David Wang
items.content: The voting system is so transparent, and the contribution-weighted mechanism is very fair. After two weeks, our member satisfaction has skyrocketed!

items.name: Emily Zhang
items.content: The timeline feature gives a clear overview of community history. New members can quickly understand the community's journey. Great product experience!

items.name: James Liu
items.content: The AI recommendation feature is really smart — it suggests suitable tasks based on members' contribution history, boosting participation efficiency.

items.name: Grace Zhao
items.content: The interface is clean and elegant, the user experience is incredibly smooth. As a designer, I really appreciate this attention to detail!

items.name: Tom Sun
items.content: Voice power management makes the community more democratic. The more you contribute, the more influence you have — that's how it should be!

items.name: Linda Zhou
items.content: Member engagement has clearly improved. Everyone is very active, and task distribution has become much more efficient 💪

items.name: Mike Wu
items.content: Voting results are public and transparent, strengthening trust among members. This is the best community governance tool I've ever used!

items.name: Sophia Zheng
items.content: Building a community governance system from scratch — YouFen makes it all so simple. Highly recommended! ✨

items.name: Chris Ma
items.content: Truly awesome! It streamlined everything we were struggling with.

items.name: Olivia Lin
items.content: Since adopting YouFen, our team collaboration efficiency has improved by at least 30%. Task allocation is more reasonable, and everyone can play to their strengths. The AI recommendation system is especially impressive!

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.intro: Welcome to YouFen. By using our service, you agree to the following terms. Please read them carefully.

sections.heading: 1. Service Description
sections.body: YouFen is a no-code community governance platform that helps community operators create and manage participation rules, track member contributions, organize voting decisions, and generate publicly verifiable records for important decisions. We leverage AI to assist with rule generation and contribution analysis, and selectively use the Injective blockchain to provide publicly verifiable records for key operations.

sections.heading: 2. Accounts and Registration
sections.body: You must create an account to use our service. You must provide accurate and complete registration information and are responsible for maintaining the security of your account. You are responsible for all activities under your account. You must be at least 13 years old (or the minimum age required in your jurisdiction) to use our service.

sections.heading: 3. Community Creation and Management
sections.body: Community operators (Owners/Managers) may customize participation rules, manage members, review contributions, and initiate polls when creating communities. Community operators are responsible for ensuring that community activities comply with applicable laws. We reserve the right to remove communities that violate these terms.

sections.heading: 4. Voice Power and Contributions
sections.body: Voice Power is a community-internal participation weight. It does not represent monetary value, financial assets, or tradable rights. Voice Power is non-transferable, non-withdrawable, and cannot be exchanged for fiat currency or cryptocurrency. Community operators have final authority over the allocation and usage rules of Voice Power within their communities.

sections.heading: 5. Voting and Decisions
sections.body: Community voting results are determined by community operators and members. Unless an on-chain trusted record is generated, voting data is stored on centralized servers. We make no guarantees regarding the accuracy, fairness, or legal effect of voting results.

sections.heading: 6. AI Features
sections.body: We use AI technology to assist with rule generation, contribution analysis, and content optimization. AI-generated content is advisory only; the final decision always rests with the user. AI may produce inaccurate or biased results, and you should exercise independent judgment before acting on AI suggestions. We make no guarantees regarding the accuracy, completeness, or suitability of AI-generated content.

sections.heading: 7. Blockchain Trusted Records
sections.body: We may generate publicly verifiable records on the Injective blockchain network for important community operations (e.g., voting results, rule changes). You understand and agree that: (a) on-chain records are public and immutable; (b) once recorded on-chain, we cannot delete or modify them; (c) we do not guarantee continuous availability of the on-chain recording feature — network congestion or technical failures may affect record generation.

sections.heading: 8. Prohibited Conduct
sections.body: You may not: (a) upload or disseminate illegal, infringing, defamatory, obscene, harassing, or otherwise inappropriate content; (b) impersonate others or provide false information; (c) interfere with or disrupt our service; (d) attempt unauthorized access to our systems; (e) abuse the Voice Power system for fraud or manipulation; (f) use automated tools for vote manipulation, contribution farming, or other cheating; (g) use the service for any illegal or unauthorized purpose.

sections.heading: 9. Intellectual Property
sections.body: The YouFen name, logo, website code, and design elements are our intellectual property. Content created by users within their communities (including rules, poll descriptions, contribution records, etc.) belongs to the users, but you grant us a license to use, display, and store such content as necessary to provide the service.

sections.heading: 10. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: The service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of the service, including but not limited to data loss, business interruption, or lost profits.

sections.heading: 11. Termination
sections.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms at any time. You may stop using the service at any time. Upon termination, community data may be retained for public record purposes, while data already recorded on-chain cannot be removed.

sections.heading: 12. Changes to Terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Material changes will be communicated via website notice or email. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

sections.heading: 13. Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about these terms, please contact us via GitHub Issues at github.com/Simon-Snow/YouFen, or email the project maintainer.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: YouFen values your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect the following types of information: (a) Account information: name and email address provided during registration; (b) Community data: communities you create or participate in, contribution records, Voice Power data, and voting records; (c) Usage data: technical information about how you interact with our service, including IP address, browser type, access times, and page views; (d) Communications: any content, feedback, or communications you submit through our platform.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your information to: (a) provide, maintain, and improve our community governance services; (b) create and manage your account and communities; (c) display contribution records, Voice Power, and voting activities within communities (subject to community visibility settings); (d) provide context for AI features to generate suggestions and summaries; (e) communicate with you about service changes, security updates, and support matters; (f) monitor and analyze usage trends to improve user experience; (g) detect, prevent, and respond to fraud or abuse.

sections.heading: 3. AI Data Processing
sections.body: When you use AI features (such as rule generation, contribution analysis, or poll summaries), content you input is sent to our AI service providers (including OpenAI and/or Anthropic) for processing. This content is used solely to generate AI responses and is not used to train AI models. AI providers will not use your data for their own model improvement purposes.

sections.heading: 4. Blockchain Data
sections.body: When you choose to generate publicly verifiable records for certain operations, a hash of the relevant data is recorded on the Injective blockchain. Blockchains are public and immutable — once a data hash is recorded on-chain, it exists permanently on the blockchain and can be viewed by anyone. On-chain records do not contain personally identifiable information (PII), only community identifiers and data hashes.

sections.heading: 5. Cookies and Tracking
sections.body: We use essential cookies to maintain sessions and authentication. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings. We do not currently use third-party tracking cookies or advertising networks.

sections.heading: 6. Data Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information: (a) as public data displayed on community public pages (subject to community privacy settings); (b) with AI service providers, solely for processing AI requests; (c) with the Injective blockchain network, for generating trusted records; (d) as required by law or to protect our rights.

sections.heading: 7. Data Security
sections.body: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data. However, no internet transmission or electronic storage is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: 8. Data Retention
sections.body: We retain your personal information for the duration of your account. After account deletion, we may retain certain data for a reasonable period for backup, audit, or legal compliance purposes. Data already recorded on the blockchain cannot be removed.

sections.heading: 9. Your Rights
sections.body: You have the right to: (a) access the personal data we hold about you; (b) request correction of inaccurate data; (c) request deletion of your data (subject to exceptions such as blockchain records); (d) export your community data. To exercise these rights, please contact us via GitHub or email.

sections.heading: 10. Children's Privacy
sections.body: Our service is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we discover that we have inadvertently collected such information, we will delete it immediately.

sections.heading: 11. International Data Transfers
sections.body: Our servers may be located outside your country of residence, and data may be stored and processed in multiple jurisdictions. By using our service, you consent to such transfers.

sections.heading: 12. Changes to Policy
sections.body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be communicated via website notice or email. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

sections.heading: 13. Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us via GitHub Issues at github.com/Simon-Snow/YouFen, or email the project maintainer.
